page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a high-capacity general-purpose server instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. The hardware is powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It equips 72 dedicated vCPUs alongside 288 GB of system memory, providing a consistent 1:4 ratio of vCPU to memory (4 GB per vCPU). This balanced hardware configuration targets multi-threaded enterprise applications requiring substantial core density.

Network performance is supported by a 33 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, facilitating substantial throughput for distributed services. The instance includes 0 complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not feature local SSD or HDD storage, relying entirely on network-attached block storage for data retention. Additionally, it contains no discrete GPU acceleration capabilities.

The high core count and substantial memory capacity deliver high resource density within a single virtual instance, eliminating multi-node communication overhead for monolithic enterprise applications. Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is suited for backend application fleets, container orchestration platforms, high-traffic web servers, continuous integration pipelines, and general-purpose database instances requiring high network bandwidth.

The high vCPU count and balanced memory allocation offer strong compute density for resource-intensive workloads such as enterprise web application clusters, container orchestrators, general-purpose processing pipelines, and mid-tier backend services.
